original_vs_transformed_consistency.title: Original-vs-transformed consistency
original_vs_transformed_consistency.statistic_description: raw COCO AP/AR with each model's original detections as the reference and the transformed detections as the prediction (no baseline subtraction)

gt_accuracy_degradation.title: Ground-truth accuracy degradation from transformation
gt_accuracy_degradation.statistic_description: original_vs_gt AP/AR (untransformed detections vs. real ground truth; a per-model baseline constant across rules) minus transformed_vs_gt AP/AR (transformed detections vs. real ground truth)

classification.equivalent: complete interval within the equivalence margins
classification.meaningfully_different: complete interval beyond one equivalence margin

validation.interpretation: Only the 'full' arm is checked against the stored per-variant stats.json AP/AR values (it uses every declared image, like the stored evaluation). The stored stats.json AP/AR values are used directly as the reported 'full' arm point estimate in the results below; this check confirms the bootstrap's own recomputation agrees with them. Differences are expected where the stored evaluation excluded images with zero detections. After model filtering, values_checked is reconstructed from unique retained comparison/model/setting/metric evidence, including original-vs-GT baselines. Agreement and disagreement counts are unavailable because per-model recomputation discrepancies were not saved. The recorded maximum and all_within_tolerance=false remain valid because the maximum belongs to a retained model. No evaluation or bootstrap was rerun.
